scope: superficial bite or scratch from a known domestic animal with controllable bleeding and no high-risk features; excludes bats, wild or unknown animals, and any deep or high-risk bite
patterns: my dog gave me a small bite
a cat scratched and bit my hand
a bat may have touched me
child was bitten by an unknown dog
animal bite getting red and swollen
response: If it is bleeding, apply direct pressure with a clean cloth. Wash and flush the wound thoroughly with soap and running water, then cover it with a clean dressing. Because of infection, tetanus, and rabies risk, contact a clinician or local health service for guidance, especially for any bite that breaks the skin.
red_flags: uncontrolled bleeding or a deep puncture
bite on the hand, face, foot, genitals, or near a joint
bat, wild, unknown, or unvaccinated animal, or an animal acting strangely
human bite, or a bite in someone with a weakened immune system
increasing redness, warmth, swelling, or pus over the next 1 to 2 days
tetanus status not up to date
